author: manniman84
quote:
The remake proves that the original is the best game ever made. Had it been released for the first time (and not as a remake), it would still be the best game ever made. The graphics are breathtaking, the art is splendid: this is how remakes should look, it's not ultra realist slop and doesn't look like it's just AI remodeled like most modern games. The character designs are gorgeous. The remastered orchestral scores of the OST are epic, majestic. You can feel the love that all the people involved in this remake have for this franchise! 

And of course, the story and characters need no re-introduction. THIS is how a remake should always be done, by keeping true to the original spirit of the game and improving tactfully with the newer technology. 100/100
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: manniman84
quote: Played this as a kid. The best game ever made, period. Innovative, immersive, the best OST in gaming history. I also bought the Switch 2 remake and it holds up just as well. No spoilers since you all probably know the story by now since it's the best, most famous game ever.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: manniman84
quote:
First, the map is gigantic and there's so many details in everything that it's basically a simulation of real life. That being said, it doesn't feel like a GTA game (I own Vice City, san Andreas, GTA 4, GtA 5) since the premise of the game is undermined by the fact that you have a romantic relationship. It is different to other GTA games in that sense it is not better, it's actually a detriment. you can feel this throughout the game but especially in the first 10 hours (!): I nearly quit after a couple of hours since almost everything was doing mundane things for Lucia. I am currently about 25 hours and it is barely getting better. Furthermore, you cannot cheat on Lucia by hiring pr0-sti-tutes (they don't exist which goes against everything that GTA is) or even with the hot neighbor Mandy: yet another way that devs handcuffed the males that play this game because of the ''love story'' that they inserted (''Hold down R2 to hold Lucia's hand'' lol). Oh and you cannot carjack every car, you need special keys to steal the nice ones: also the driving is very stiff, it is not as fun as GTA 5 if you choose to just drive around.  

All in all, this is a huge disappointment, it does not live up to the hype and I regret having bought it, this is NOT EVEN CLOSE of being a 10/10 game, it isn't even the best GTA game (GTA 4 and 5 clear this one easily). It's like RDR2 but with GTAish flavor and it just doesn't work, especially with how they handcuffed the main character with the love story premise and how bland and completely **** Jason is and how annoying the other (Lucia) is. Amazing realism with simulation level of details and huge map but this is not a GTA game, it is soulless and the story is boring, bland, a 2/10 without exaggeration, this game is in no way revolutionary and might actually signal the beginning of the end for GTA, despite the pre-order sales and financial sucess, unless they do a complete 180.
